confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and hostel anchors are more reliable than the hotel_3star and cocktail anchors, which vary more widely. Phnom Penh prices are largely quoted in USD. FX value 0.6955 for 2026-10-15 was taken from a search summary that reported the RBA figure. I did not open the RBA page itself, and no 2026-10-16 RBA observation was confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is the budget-to-midrange tiers of Southeast Asian USD-dollarized tourist cities, cross-referenced against Siem Reap and Ho Chi Minh City. Phnom Penh is generally priced below Bangkok for comparable tiers. Drink anchors use a local beer-relative ratio where direct knowledge is weaker: cocktail and wine are roughly 4x and 5x the draft beer anchor.
